name: I&M Bank
verdict: Group holding company I&M Group PLC is listed on the Nairobi Securities Exchange, with private holding companies among its large shareholders. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Official Banking Partner and back-of-jersey sponsor of Nairobi City Thunder from 25 May 2026. I&M Group PLC is NSE-listed; the significant (>5%) shareholders it names are private holding companies, nominee accounts and a charitable foundation. No state stake among them was found, and no human-rights finding against the bank or its parent was found.
